blocks.prompt: 4. For what value of \(n\), \(\frac{a^{n} + b^{n}}{a^{n-1} + b^{n-1}}\) is the positive geometric mean between \(a\) and \(b\)?
blocks.explanation:
Humein woh \(n\) chahiye jis par yeh fraction positive G.M. \(\sqrt{ab}\) ke barabar ho jaye. Hum maan lete hain ke \(a, b\) positive hain aur \(a \neq b\).
Plan: \(\sqrt{ab}\) ko powers mein \(a^{1/2}b^{1/2}\) likhenge, cross multiply karenge, terms ek taraf la kar pairs mein factorise karenge, aur aakhir mein \(a \neq b\) istemal karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a > 0\), \(b > 0\), \(a \neq b\).
Humein find karna hai: woh \(n\) jis par fraction \(= \sqrt{ab}\).
Tareeqa: Positive G.M. ko indices (powers) ki shakal mein likhenge: \(\sqrt{ab} = a^{\frac{1}{2}}b^{\frac{1}{2}}\). Is se laws of indices (powers ke qawaid) lagana aasan ho jata hai, kyunke sawal mein bhi \(a^{n}\), \(a^{n-1}\) jaisi powers hain.

Fraction ko G.M. ke barabar rakhein
\[\dfrac{a^{n} + b^{n}}{a^{n-1} + b^{n-1}} = a^{\frac{1}{2}}b^{\frac{1}{2}}\]
Kyun: Sawal yahi keh raha hai ke fraction positive G.M. ho.

Cross multiply karein aur bracket kholein
\[a^{n} + b^{n} = a^{\frac{1}{2}}b^{\frac{1}{2}}(a^{n-1} + b^{n-1})\]
\[= a^{n-\frac{1}{2}}b^{\frac{1}{2}} + a^{\frac{1}{2}}b^{n-\frac{1}{2}}\]
Kyun: Neeche wala bracket doosri taraf multiply ho gaya. Ek hi base ki powers multiply hon to powers jama hoti hain: \(a^{\frac{1}{2}} \cdot a^{n-1} = a^{\frac{1}{2} + n - 1} = a^{n-\frac{1}{2}}\). Isi tarah \(b\) ke liye.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{1}{2} + n - 1\) ko \(n + \frac{1}{2}\) mat likhiye; \(1 - \frac{1}{2}\) nikal kar \(n - \frac{1}{2}\) banta hai.

Saare terms ek taraf layein
\[a^{n} - a^{n-\frac{1}{2}}b^{\frac{1}{2}} + b^{n} - a^{\frac{1}{2}}b^{n-\frac{1}{2}} = 0\]
Kyun: Terms ko is tarah tarteeb diya ke \(a\) ki bari power wale do terms saath hon aur \(b\) ki bari power wale do terms saath. Is se agle step mein pairs bana kar factorise karna aasan hai.

Pairs mein factorise karein
\[a^{n-\frac{1}{2}}(a^{\frac{1}{2}} - b^{\frac{1}{2}}) - b^{n-\frac{1}{2}}(a^{\frac{1}{2}} - b^{\frac{1}{2}}) = 0\]
\[(a^{\frac{1}{2}} - b^{\frac{1}{2}})(a^{n-\frac{1}{2}} - b^{n-\frac{1}{2}}) = 0\]
Kyun: Pehle pair se \(a^{n-\frac{1}{2}}\) common liya, kyunke \(a^{n-\frac{1}{2}} \cdot a^{\frac{1}{2}} = a^{n}\). Doosre pair se \(-b^{n-\frac{1}{2}}\) common liya, to andar bhi \((a^{\frac{1}{2}} - b^{\frac{1}{2}})\) bacha. Dono hisson mein ek hi bracket aa gaya, use bahar nikal liya.

\(a \neq b\) istemal karein
\[a^{n-\frac{1}{2}} = b^{n-\frac{1}{2}}\]
\[\left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right)^{n-\frac{1}{2}} = 1\]
Kyun: Do cheezon ka product zero ho to kam az kam ek zero hoti hai. Pehla bracket \(\sqrt{a} - \sqrt{b}\) zero nahi ho sakta kyunke \(a \neq b\). Is liye doosra bracket zero hai. Phir dono taraf \(b^{n-\frac{1}{2}}\) se divide kiya.

\(n\) nikalein
\[n - \dfrac{1}{2} = 0\]
\[n = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{a}{b}\) ek positive number hai jo 1 nahi. Aisa number 1 sirf tab banta hai jab us ki power zero ho, kyunke \(x^{0} = 1\). Is liye power \(n - \frac{1}{2}\) zero hai.

Tasdeeq: \(n = \frac{1}{2}\) rakh kar dekhein
\[\dfrac{a^{\frac{1}{2}} + b^{\frac{1}{2}}}{a^{-\frac{1}{2}} + b^{-\frac{1}{2}}} = \dfrac{\sqrt{a} + \sqrt{b}}{\frac{\sqrt{a} + \sqrt{b}}{\sqrt{ab}}}\]
\[= \sqrt{ab}\]
Kyun: \(a^{-\frac{1}{2}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{a}}\), is liye neeche \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{a}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{b}} = \frac{\sqrt{a} + \sqrt{b}}{\sqrt{ab}}\) bana. Fraction se divide karna ulta kar ke multiply karna hai; \(\sqrt{a} + \sqrt{b}\) cancel ho gaya aur \(\sqrt{ab}\) bacha. Misaal: \(a = 2, b = 8\) par fraction \(= 4 = \sqrt{16}\).
